children.name: Cephalaria graminifolia Steud., 1841
children.description: A member of the genus Cephalaria (family Caprifoliaceae, historically Dipsacaceae), a group of scabious-like herbs with pincushion flower-heads native to southern Europe, western and central Asia, and Africa. This particular Steudel name (1841) is treated by IPNI and POWO as an orthographic error published in synonymy, so no distinct species-level treatment is attached to it.
